story_overview: A group of operatives navigates a clandestine mission across a city at night. Chloe and Arthur share a moment of vulnerability on a bus before they are all drawn into a wider conspiracy at a grand train station involving Alex, Julian, Walter, Simon, Amelie, and Nina. As the plot unfolds, Isabelle and Simon track their targets with an electronic device, while a police investigation complicates matters at a gothic hotel.
